title: Animal Hospital Auto Heart Safe Treatments Patient ESP
features:
Treatment and patient tools
- Auto Heart Minigame
- Safe Treatments
- Prevent Sanity Loss
- Dynamic active-patient selector
- Teleport to selected patient
- Teleport to the nearest medical station

Prompt tools
- Instant held proximity prompts
- Extended prompt range from 8 to 13 studs

ESP and awareness
- Player ESP
- Patient ESP
- Required Medicine ESP
- NPC ESP
- Work Prompt ESP
- Camera ESP
- Station ESP
- Adjustable ESP distance

Movement
- Walk speed from 16 to 120
- Jump power from 50 to 160
- Noclip
- Infinite Jump

Visuals and interface
- Full Bright and No Fog
- Disable Rendering
- FOV from 40 to 120
- Local atmosphere, lighting, postprocessing, and character personalization
- Themes, UI scaling, saved configs, and unload

HOW TO USE

1. Join Animal Hospital.
2. Execute the public StackZero loader from the Script field below.
3. Complete the free key process and enter the key when prompted.
4. Select an active patient or enable the ESP categories needed for the current task.
5. Enable Auto Heart, Safe Treatments, prompt tools, or sanity protection separately as needed.

DEFAULT CONTROLS

- Right Shift: open or close the main menu
- N: toggle Noclip
- P: teleport to the selected patient
- M: teleport to the nearest medical station
- K: toggle the keybind menu
